name: Omarchy Broadcast
author: Raul Dias
description: Status and control of the omarchy-broadcastd virtual camera in the Omarchy bar: on/off, camera selection, background effect selector (none, blur, replace), a noise removal switch, the camera's own settings as the daemon publishes them (image, white balance, exposure, focus and zoom; need omarchy-broadcast 0.22.0), a live preview and live stream figures.

barWidget.description: Shows the virtual camera's state; left click opens the panel with the live preview, effects, cameras and status, right click turns the camera on or off.

schema.label: omarchy-broadcast CLI path
schema.description: Optional. Absolute path to the omarchy-broadcast binary (a leading ~/ is your home); a bare name or a relative path is refused. Empty: omarchy-broadcast on PATH.

schema.label: Preview in the panel
schema.description: On: opening the panel starts the camera and shows what apps receive. Off: the panel shows the preview only while another app already uses the camera. Needs omarchy-broadcast 0.18 or newer.

schema.label: Preview rate
schema.description: 15 or 30 frames per second; any other value reads as 15.

schema.label: Panel tab
schema.description: The tab the panel shows under the preview; the panel remembers the last one chosen. Any other value reads as effect.
